title: msaa_2d combined with scaling_3d_scale < 1.0 and screen_space_aa causes error
body:
### Tested versions

4.7.1-stable

### System information

windows11, forward+(d3d12) and mobile

### Issue description

When msaa_2d is enabled alongside a low 3D render scale (scaling_3d_scale < 1.0, e.g., 0.3) and Screen Space Anti-Aliasing (screen_space_aa) makes error

### Steps to reproduce

```gdscript
get_window().scaling_3d_scale = 0.3
get_window().msaa_2d = Viewport.MSAA_2X
get_window().screen_space_aa = Viewport.SCREEN_SPACE_AA_FXAA # or SMAA
```
